profile.headline: Software Engineer @ LIDP Consulting Services
profile.summary: Dedicated Full-Stack Software Engineer with a passion for developing innovative solutions in the healthcare industry. With over three years of professional experience, I specialize in both backend and frontend development, leveraging technologies such as Python, Java, JavaScript, React, Spring Boot and Django

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Automated and scaled a data processing system that previously required months of manual work to handle 1000 data sources, reducing processing time to under 2 hours—a 99% improvement. Leveraged Python, Django ORM, Redis, and Celery to streamline bulk data insertions and implement real-time error tracking. Enabled engineers to access and utilize 800% more actionable data endpoints, enhancing operational efficiency and accelerating decision-making.

- Enhanced a React-based patient health application by enabling secure QR code scanning for seamless access to individual health records. Designed and implemented new features using React and TypeScript on the frontend. Built a scalable backend with AWS Lambda, Docker (via ECR), S3 for object storage, and API Gateway for authentication and authorization. Optimized the application for efficient data processing and improved patient experience.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Application Development and +43 skills

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Onboarded Smart Health Card issuers, guiding them through implementation processes and ensuring seamless integration with HL7 FHIR standards. Acted as a consultant, providing technical expertise and troubleshooting support to streamline adoption and compliance, contributing to the expansion and reliability of the digital health ecosystem.

- Analyzed technical requirements from international and U.S. government entities for COVID-19 digital health records, delivering a functional application that facilitated the reopening of global tourism and exceeded stakeholder expectations.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Application Development and +22 skills
